rationale: Describes an HTML5 UI framework with widgets, data-visualization components, a client-side data source, and an MVVM library, conventional interface and application-development components.
evidence_spans: comprehensive HTML5 user interface framework for building interactive and high-performance websites and applications
library of 70+ UI widgets, an abundance of data-visualization gadgets, client-side data source, and a built-in MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) library
